Pixel OS v2.1.7-b1 — Opt-In iOS Style UI Beta on Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Optical UDFPS Registration & Calibration Fix (Goodix G3 / GF9500): enabled Goodix G3 SPMT panel calibration compatibility in /odm/lib64/libgf_hal_G3.so (vendor.fingerprint.cali=1), linked SDM/DRM FOD plane promotion directly into composer@2.4-service via /vendor/lib64/libdisplaydebug.so with live /sys/kernel/oppo_display/fp_state touch-state tracking, and gated the 190x190 optical lightspot overlay strictly to finger press
• Full Android 17 Developer Options Launcher in iOS Settings: added 'Open Full Android Developer Options' at the top of Developer Options in IosSettings so users can access all 80+ native Android 17 Developer Options alongside the iOS quick toggles
• Direct Single-Swipe Primary Bouncer Unlock + Single-Press Optical UDFPS Aperture (IosControlCenter v1.7.7-ios26) & 90Hz AGSL Liquid Glass Sheets
